availabilityScope: Development application and tested native adapters. A conditional verb also requires live source and operation admission. Release package qualification is tracked separately.

limitations: Read-only regression fixtures pass on the ordinary host and guest users; sparse/compressed/resident/preallocation/cloud/filter and filesystem matrices remain unqualified.
Explicit file-root fixture denies primary content reads and permits metadata observations.
Total reported block allocation; not exclusive ownership or primary-fork-only allocation.
Basic fixture only; clones, forks, mounts, cloud and substitution matrix remain unqualified.
Raw non-UTF-8 names have no qualified recursive macOS route.
Requires statx mount identity and openat2 containment; btrfs object uniqueness is not asserted without subvolume identity.
Initial ext4 regressions and native desktop subsets pass; broader filesystem, cloud, race and resource matrices remain unqualified.
